sections.title: Dont disturb threshold
sections.description: The threshold/delta between emails to one subcriber. If the threshold is not reached, the email will not be sent. We dont want to bother subscribers that did recieve email aready lately.

fields.title: Time between the subscriber is contacred again (in seconds)

sections.title: Time between emails (in seconds)
sections.description: Set the time between emails. If to send out with some delay.

sections.title: Logging
sections.description: Enable file-based logging to record plugin actions to daily log files. Logs are stored in {uploads}/gae-logs/mawiblah-YYYY-MM-DD.log and can be viewed under Mawiblah → Logs.

fields.title: Slack webhook URL
fields.help_text: Optional: an incoming webhook URL (https://hooks.slack.com/services/...) that log entries are also posted to. Leave empty to send nothing to Slack. Anyone holding this URL can post to the channel, so treat it as a credential. The test button posts to whatever is in this field, saved or not.

fields.title: Send to Slack
fields.help_text: Errors are posted even when file logging is off. Every log entry means one HTTP request per entry, and Slack rate-limits a webhook to about one message per second — only worth it while chasing a specific problem, not during a campaign send.

sections.title: Failing Email
sections.description: If sending to a subscriber fails this many times across all campaigns, they are automatically added to the 'Failing Email' audience and skipped in future sends.

fields.title: Failure threshold (number of failed sends before marking as Failing Email)

sections.title: reCAPTCHA v3 (Subscription Form)
sections.description: Optional Google reCAPTCHA v3 protection for the subscription form. Leave disabled to rely on honeypot only. Get your keys at https://www.google.com/recaptcha/admin/

sections.title: Email Open Tracking
sections.description: Embeds a 1×1 tracking pixel in outgoing emails. Requires server-side configuration (nginx must serve the pixel URL and execute PHP). When enabled, unique opens are recorded per subscriber per campaign. Note: inform subscribers in your privacy policy.

sections.title: Background Send (WP Cron)
sections.description: Settings for background campaign sending via WP Cron. Campaigns can be sent in the background so you can close the browser tab.

sections.title: Scheduler
sections.description: How often WP Cron checks whether a scheduled campaign is due. Lower values mean sends fire closer to the configured time, but generate more cron runs.
